rationale: Base station storage was at 99% with loop recording disabled, triggering error E-402, which stops new event clips from being recorded while live view (streaming) still works. The customer's broadband was not the cause — uplink status was OK and all devices online. Enabling loop recording resolved the issue, with new clips appearing within minutes.

repair_steps: Confirm base station storage is no longer full and loop recording is enabled.
Verify new event clips are being recorded and appear in the event list.
Advise customer to export any important clips before formatting storage if needed.
output.customer_reply: We've resolved the issue by enabling loop recording on your base station. New event clips are now being saved normally. If you need to keep any older clips, please export them soon, as loop recording will overwrite the oldest clips when storage is full. Thank you for your patience!

results.text: Base station storage at or above 98 percent with loop recording disabled. Frontline action: enable loop recording or format storage.

Event clips are stored on the base station's internal eMMC (HB-100: 16 GB, HB-200: 32 GB). When loop recording is disabled and storage reaches 98 percent, new events are not recorded and error E-402 is shown. Enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or format the storage after exporting clips.

Solid blue: online and connected to cloud. Blinking blue: pairing mode (lasts 120 seconds). Solid red: no internet uplink. Blinking red: booting or firmware update in progress, do not unplug. Solid purple: storage almost full (over 95 percent).
